desc:
Mion is a stylized kid character in a cel-shaded, animated-film style: big curly hair, a bold patterned windbreaker, shorts and chunky sneakers. The look is made to pop on small screens and still feel premium on PC.

He's 20K tris on a single 2K texture set, with clean shapes and flat, graphic color that suit toon shading in Unreal Engine 5. A second outfit, a plain blue hoodie with different sneakers, uses the same body and texture layout, which shows how quickly he can be reskinned. Topology is clean and deformation-ready for rigging and animation.

Making a stylized mobile or cross-platform game with a young cast? We can match this look, or take it wherever your project needs to go.
software: ZBrush, Maya, Substance Painter, Unreal Engine
